legenda: October 1892: five Army engineers, unanimous for San Pedro.
texto_para_tela: UNANIMOUS · five Army engineers, October 1892 · San Pedro · 1891 · 1892
nota: A sessão final começou em 25/10/1892; o relatório é de 27/10/1892.
narracao: In October 1892, a second board of five Army engineers chose San Pedro unanimously. Picking Santa Monica, they wrote, would leave the government keeping "two harbors where one would answer the purpose." The second board had said the same as the first.
